title: buda glandulosa
intro: Buda glandulosa, commonly known as the Desert Lavender or Lavender of the Desert, is a flowering plant native to the southwestern United States. It is known for its potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation, improving sleep quality, and calming the nervous system. The therapeutic actions of Buda glandulosa include its sedative, antispasmodic, and anti-inflammatory properties, which make it useful in treating anxiety, insomnia, and muscle spasms. The bioactive constituents of Buda glandulosa include essential oils, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, such as linalool and camphor, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
